selection.effect: Admit the exact-hash Product Capability and product ontology for this integration epoch, pass G-D65-PRODUCT, and make D65-S3 eligible for separate capability-local business-ontology authoring.
selection.reversibility: A later explicit product-ontology owner decision may supersede this admission; the exact candidate, evidence, and this decision remain immutable history.

admitted_product_meaning.canonical_truth: Canonical per-node and per-relation event histories calculate ontology state.
admitted_product_meaning.context_boundary: A governed Context consumes an exact-cut projection and never becomes canonical ontology truth or a replay source.
admitted_product_meaning.failure_boundary: Stale, mixed, missing, or unverifiable event cuts are rejected and remain challengeable through the named owner routes.

non_effects: This decision does not change the immutable candidate package or promote integration-local definitions into canonical definitions.
This decision does not author or admit the D65-S3 capability-local business ontology or business-system bridge.
This decision does not author DomainSpec source, compile a graph or system ontology, accept an implementation binding, or mutate Rust code.
This decision does not authorize migration, cutover, publication, release, deployment, credentials, destructive action, or external effects.
This decision does not make Invoke a predecessor, dependency, validator, admission source, or execution route.
claim_ceiling: Exact product-ontology owner admission for D65-S2 of one integration epoch. D65-S3 becomes eligible but remains blocked at G-D65-BUSINESS until its own business ontology is authored, validated, and admitted; no implementation or external effect is authorized.
